verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS virtual-mailbox platform, so asking about versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question. The evidence pack describes only phone-app and web-portal mail management, though, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. There is no evidence of a public API, API versioning, or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
